class.name: IfcMaterialConstituentSet
class.brief_description: IfcMaterialConstituentSet is a collection of individual material constituents, each assigning a material to a part of an element. The parts are only identified by a keyword (as opposed to an IfcMaterialLayerSet or IfcMaterialProfileSet where each part has an individual shape parameter (layer thickness or layer profile). EXAMPLE The different materials of a window construction shall be provided for
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: The name by which the constituent set is known. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Definition of the material constituent set in descriptive terms. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

Identification of the constituents from which the material constituent set is composed. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
